episodes.title: Épisode I
episodes.summary: The year is 50… no, wait, it's 78 B.C.! In a village in Gaul, Getafix is working on a magic potion and Obelix doesn't yet have superhuman strength.

episodes.title: Épisode II
episodes.summary: Determined to defeat the indomitable Gauls, Caesar decides to use their own laws against them. In the forest, Getafix comes across some pesky Romans...

episodes.title: Épisode III
episodes.summary: A Gallo-Roman chieftain challenges Vitalstatistix. Meanwhile, a centurion spies on Getafix, who tries to make the magic potion with explosive results.

episodes.title: Épisode IV
episodes.summary: With the fight fast approaching, the Gauls desperately search for another way to win — stirring even more trouble between Asterix and Obelix.

episodes.title: Épisode V
episodes.summary: As the Romans' dastardly plans for Gaul reach a boiling point, Metadata questions her loyalty and Asterix pulls out all the stops to save the village.
